name: interview-prep-copilot
description: A local desktop copilot for interview preparation and practice.

scripts.test:realtime-renewal: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-realtime-renewal.cjs
scripts.test:realtime-renewal-live: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/live-realtime-speaker-e2e.cjs --renew
scripts.test:document-import: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-document-import.cjs
scripts.test:realtime-context-live: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/live-realtime-speaker-e2e.cjs --context
scripts.test:realtime-speaker-live: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/live-realtime-speaker-e2e.cjs
scripts.test:realtime-voice: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-realtime-voice.cjs
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 node scripts/run-electron.cjs .
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-core-e2e.cjs
scripts.test:voice-screen-followup: npm run build && cross-env VOICE_TEST_ROUTING=voicemeeter node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-voice-screen-followup.cjs --fresh
scripts.test:knowledge: npm run build && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-knowledge.cjs
scripts.test:sessions: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-sessions.cjs
scripts.test:context: npm run build && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-context.cjs
scripts.test:embeddings: npm run build && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-embeddings.cjs
scripts.test:codex: npm run build && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-codex.cjs
scripts.test:personal-context: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-personal-context.cjs
scripts.test:job-description: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-job-description-ui.cjs
scripts.test:scenarios: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-scenarios.cjs
scripts.test:screen-question: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-screen-question.cjs && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-overlay-monitor.cjs
scripts.test:screen-question-ocr: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-screen-question-ocr.cjs
scripts.test:overlay: npm run build && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-overlay-monitor.cjs
scripts.test:screen-capture: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-primary-screen.cjs
scripts.test:transcription-worker: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-transcription-worker.cjs
scripts.test:codex-connection: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-codex-discovery.cjs && node scripts/smoke-codex-connection.cjs
scripts.test:capture-protection: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-capture-protection.cjs
scripts.test:windows-exclusion: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-windows-exclusion.cjs && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-windows-exclusion.cjs --overlay
scripts.test:assist-turns: npm run build && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-assist-turns.cjs
scripts.test:windows-loopback: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-windows-loopback.cjs
scripts.test:windows-spoken-question: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-windows-spoken-question.cjs
scripts.test:desktop-transcripts: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-desktop-transcripts.cjs
scripts.test:chatgpt-desktop-e2e: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-windows-spoken-question.cjs --chatgpt-desktop
scripts.test:assist-ui: npm run build && cross-env INTERVIEW_COPILOT_REFERENCE_DIR=knowledge/reference node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-assist-ui.cjs
scripts.test:overlay-assistant: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-overlay-assistant.cjs
scripts.test:voice-mirror: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-voice-reply-parser.cjs && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-voice-mirror.cjs
scripts.test:voice-mirror-live: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-voice-mirror-live.cjs
scripts.test:voice-audio-e2e: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-voice-audio-e2e.cjs
